name: Visions Of The Future
overview: The Scriptures reveal that visions of the future are deeply rooted in God's sovereign plan and the work of the Holy Spirit, who grants wisdom, understanding, and counsel (Isaiah 11:2). The resurrection of Christ, foretold and witnessed, assures believers of victory over death and the hope of eternal life (Acts 2:31). As followers of Christ, we are called to repent and receive the Holy Spirit, who empowers us to live in peace and anticipation of God's promises (Acts 2:38; John 20:19). Acknowledging our sinfulness and need for grace (Romans 3:23), we trust in the Lord as our shepherd who provides and sustains us through all things (Psalms 23:1).
